prompt:
Create a Nintendo DS-era Pokémon Black/White inspired 2D pixel art sprite sheet for a young elf ranger girl named Aileen. Full-body chibi trainer proportions, big head and small body, about 64 px tall total, exactly 2 tiles high. Transparent background only. Top-down RPG overworld sprite style with slight 3/4 torso readability like Pokémon BW trainers, clean readable silhouette at small size, crisp 1 px dark outline, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no painterly shading.

Sheet layout: 4 directions x 4 walking frames. Rows in this order: down, left, up, right. Each row contains a smooth 4-frame walk cycle. Keep the same body proportions, same outfit design, and consistent pose logic in every direction. Frame spacing should be even and aligned to a strict grid. Sprite cell size should be 64x64 px per frame, total sheet around 256x256 px.

Character design: silver-white high ponytail with a clear tied hair mass and visible swing motion, pointed elf ears, bright green eyes, dark green ranger outfit with fitted tunic, short boots, simple belt, subtle leather straps, and a compact bow. Make the bow readable at small scale without overpowering the silhouette. Her face should be cute and youthful, with a large head, small hands, short legs, and a light adventurer stance. Use saturated but controlled Pokémon BW colors: deep forest green, emerald accents, silver-white hair, warm skin tones, dark brown leather, small gold details. Keep the palette limited and clean, with flat pixel color blocks and minimal shading bands typical of DS-era sprite art.

Animation direction: down-facing frame should show the face and bow clearly; left and right frames should mirror the stance properly with the ponytail and bow shifting naturally; up-facing frame should show the back of the head, ponytail, and ranger outfit clearly. Feet should alternate in a simple classic RPG walk cycle. No pose drift between directions. No scene background, no ground plane, no UI, no extra props, no text, no border.
rationale: 参考图的问题主要在于：主体信息不够强，黑底或深色区域容易把轮廓吞掉；角色细节在小尺寸下粘连，导致发型、精灵耳、弓和服装层次不够清楚；整体更像缩小后的插图，而不是原生 NDS/BW 像素精灵。当前版本把规格锁死到 64px 高、透明底、4 向 4 帧、严格网格和 1px 描边，这样能避免缩放后发糊。还把角色特征拆成了可读性优先的像素符号：高马尾、尖耳、绿色游侠装、紧凑弓、Q 版大头小身，并且明确每个方向该显示什么，减少动作不一致和背向信息丢失的问题。

params.palette: Nintendo DS / Pokémon Black and White inspired limited palette: deep forest green, emerald, silver-white, warm skin, dark brown leather, muted gold, clean black outline
params.notes: Strict pixel art only, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no soft shading, no blur, no background, no UI, no text. Keep all frames aligned on grid and consistent in scale.

demand: 宝可梦 NDS BW 风艾琳 4 向行走角色（下/左/上/右），64px 2 瓦片高，大头 Q 版，精灵游侠少女：银白马尾/精灵耳/绿眼/深绿游侠装/弓
